_universe_note: ADDED for anti-survivorship-bias. St. Anne's closed April 2026 (124-year-old facility). At 2019 was active but Little Sisters of the Poor as an order was already in slow nationwide pullout — predictive signal for framework.
_caveat: Likely NOT a muni obligor — Little Sisters of the Poor are religious-order operators that historically self-finance. Inclusion is borderline; flagged for completeness but may be excluded from universe stats if no muni bond confirmed.

starting_ratings.note: Unrated; religious-order self-finance, no public bonds verified.

verified_outcome.outcome_class_rationale: In the 2019-2022 window itself, no default event. Post-window closure is leading-indicator signal that framework should have caught: Little Sisters of the Poor pullout pattern visible 2019.
